newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korean firms buy 15,000T China cottonseed meal.
newsitem.headline: South Korean firms buy 15,000T China cottonseed meal.

text.p: Five South Korean feed milling companies on Friday bought a combined 15,000 tonnes of Chinese cottonseed meal at $153 a tonne on a cost and freight basis, traders said.
The companies also passed on a tender for 8,000 tonnes due to high prices, they added.
The five companies included Miwon Co Ltd, Purina Korea Inc and Taihan Sugar Industrial Co Ltd, they said.
An official of the buyers group said the five companies had originally invited 23,000 tonnes of Chinese cottonseed meal.
The official said South Korean trading house LG International Corp won the contract for delivery by January 20.
Of the total amount, 10,000 tonnes will be shipped to Inchon and 5,000 tonnes to Kunsan.
